IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Sunday 22 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots. Winds may reach up to 30 knots at times.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres.
Weather: Clear.

Monday 23 November
Winds: North to northwesterly 15 to 25 knots turning westerly 20 to 30 knots in the late morning and early afternoon then tending west to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Tuesday 24 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly in the middle of the day then becoming variable below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Wednesday 25 November
Winds: Northerly 10 to 15 knots tending southerly 15 to 20 knots during the afternoon then tending west to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre during the afternoon or evening.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 26 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon then becoming variable below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
warnings: Strong Wind Warning for Monday for Derwent Estuary

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Sunday 22 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 15 to 20 knots. Winds may reach up to 30 knots at times.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres offshore.
Swell: Westerly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres offshore.
Swell: Northeasterly below 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Monday 23 November
Winds: Northwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the morning and early afternoon. Winds tending westerly in the morning.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Westerly 1.5 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 95% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore at night. Possible small hail in the evening.

Tuesday 24 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 25 knots increasing to 20 to 30 knots before dawn then tending west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Westerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres, tending southwesterly 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore in the early morning. Possible small hail in the morning and afternoon.

Wednesday 25 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending north to northwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then tending southeast to southwesterly during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
warnings: Strong Wind Warning for Monday for South East Coast
